# GENERATED by tools/regen_ld_currency_data.py (vic3_mods) -- do not edit by hand.
# the country's currency as data -- var:zz_ef_cur = flag:<cur>, set by E&F's history, the currency's introduction
# (introduction_of_<cur>) and a currency union (ld_monetary_union.txt); no var -- no currency, a national word
# (Д.R8а.2, С17; E&F's currency laws -- _archive/ef_currency_laws/, R8в). Called at the start (ld_start_setup.txt),
# a new country's init, every January (zz_ef_money_model_monthly_step), after an introduction; read by E&F's and
# the model's per-currency ladders and currency_name / currency_symbol. Table: docs/currency-table.md.
zz_ef_cur_set = {
	zz_ef_cur_names = yes
	if = { limit = { zz_ef_logs_on = yes } debug_log = "EFM|[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString]|[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]|cur_nat|[THIS.GetCountry.GetCustom('currency_name')]" }
	zz_ef_cur_par_update = yes
}

# The currency's name: its word. Every country at the game's load (on_game_started_after_lobby,
# on_actions/ld_currency_name_on_actions.txt), then with zz_ef_cur_set.
zz_ef_cur_names = {
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = zz_ef_cur } } zz_ef_cur_noun_set = yes }
	else = { zz_ef_cur_name_set = yes }
}

# The issuer's gold a unit of its money held abroad (var:zz_ef_rq_gpm -- its value against the parity,
# zz_ef_value_to_parity, Д.R8а.4) and whether it counts in an exchange standard's cover (var:zz_ef_rq_conv -- the
# issuer redeems in metal, zz_ef_convertible_v, Д.R8а.5): the register of claims values the holdings by them
# (scripted_effects/ld_claims.txt). Monthly (zz_ef_money_model_monthly_step) and with zz_ef_cur_set; last month's, so
# two issuers holding each other's money do not read each other in a loop.
zz_ef_cur_par_update = {
	if = {
		limit = { zz_ef_nr_issuer = yes }
		set_variable = { name = zz_ef_rq_gpm value = zz_ef_value_to_parity }
		set_variable = { name = zz_ef_rq_conv value = zz_ef_convertible_v }
	}
}
